study_identification_part.si_4_title: Spectral normative modeling of brain structure

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study employs Hierarchical Bayesian Regression (HBR) for normative modeling. While the paper introduces 'Spectral Normative Modeling (SNM)', the underlying statistical model used to estimate normative ranges for the spectral coefficients is HBR. It models the moments (mean and variance) of the phenotype distribution as a function of covariates, with batch effects modeled hierarchically.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: For clarity and without loss of generality, we focus on an exemplary instantiation using Hierarchical Bayesian Regression (HBR) ... HBR assumes that these observations follow a normal distribution y ~ N(mu_y, sigma^2_y) and aims to model its moments (mean and variance) as a function of covariates (age and sex) while controlling for batch effects
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Mansour2025.pdf.md: 4.8 Normative Modeling Framework / 4.8.2 Direct Method

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study models high-resolution cortical thickness (CT) estimates for each vertex of the cortical surface mesh.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Normative models have been established for numerous whole-brain and regional phenotypes, such as cortical thickness or volume... In this context, we model vertex-wise cortical thickness estimates as a brain signal.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Covariates included Age (modeled using a B-spline basis expansion, implying higher-order terms), Sex (fixed effect), and Batch/Site (random effect for dataset harmonization).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: For simplicity, we consider the covariates of age and sex... w_mu and w_sigma are weights that model the fixed effect of age by a basis expansion Phi. A B-spline basis expansion (cubic spline with three evenly spaced knots; df=5) was used to capture the non-linear effects of age. The fixed effect of sex is modeled... Batch effects (for dataset harmonization) are modeled... hierarchically modeling batch as a random effect.
